preprocessing: Provided face crops resized bilinearly to 24x24; per-image mean/std normalization. Does not test classroom face detection.
split: Identities 0–31: indices 1,4,8 held out; remaining 7 images train. Identities 32–39 entirely held out as unknown.
limitations: Unknown rejection is heuristic; thresholds not calibrated on classroom data
Dataset subjects are not enrolled students
Classroom accuracy and liveness are not measured
